company.name: Filestack
company.shortDescription: Filestack, Inc. provides a Software-as-a-Service solution to help software developers manage images, videos.
company.description: Filestack is a Content Ingestion Network - seamlessly integrating edge content within an applications cloud - reliably, scalably and securely. It is the #1 file uploading tool in the world. Developers love Filestack because of its third party integrations, easy to use API, and ability to upload, transform and deliver documents, images, videos and more.

productsAndServices.description: A customizable file uploader widget that allows users to select and upload files from multiple sources with support for folder uploads and client-side image transformations.
productsAndServices.name: File Picker

productsAndServices.description: An API that enables developers to upload files and videos from any source, including URL ingestion and mobile device integration, with enhanced reliability and security.
productsAndServices.name: Upload API

productsAndServices.description: An API that performs image, video, and document transformations, conversions, and optimizations on files before they reach the application.
productsAndServices.name: Transformations API

productsAndServices.description: A content delivery service that optimizes and securely delivers responsive audio, video, image, and document files globally, including an embeddable file viewer.
productsAndServices.name: Delivery Service (CDN and Viewer)

productsAndServices.description: APIs that analyze and understand uploaded content using AI, including object detection, explicit content detection, image tagging, captioning, emotion analysis, and phishing detection.
productsAndServices.name: Content Intelligence APIs

productsAndServices.description: An SDK that extracts text and data from documents by digitizing scanned images and PDFs automatically.
productsAndServices.name: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) SDK
